summary: preinstall hook downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: @ornikar/eslint-config-node@12.2.2 declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs is obfuscated (rotating string-array decoder, _0x-style identifiers) and at install time detects the host platform, downloads the Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<arch>.zip, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~727KB '@bun @bun-cjs' file with heavy string-array/rotator obfuscation; it is not referenced from index.js and is unrelated to the package's advertised eslint-config purpose. Executing an opaque obfuscated payload through a fetched alternate runtime at preinstall time results in arbitrary code execution on any developer or CI machine that runs `npm install`. The package's advertised purpose is a static eslint configuration; there is no linting reason to ship or execute a Bun-run bundled payload. Combined with the trusted-looking @ornikar scope, this has the shape of a compromised-publisher republish or account/token takeover.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
